name: May Mobility
sub: Robotaxi & passenger L4; AV middleware, dev platforms & tooling
about: Autonomous shuttle and ridehail operator focused on constrained ODDs, transit-style deployments and Toyota Sienna Autono-MaaS platforms.
model: Service contracts with cities, campuses and mobility partners; AV technology stack
financing: Late-stage private; Series D reported in 2023 led by NTT
investors: NTT, Toyota, BMW i Ventures, Uber
deployment: Ann Arbor, Peachtree Corners, Sun City, Arlington, Grand Rapids in Minnesota and Japan; on Lyft in Atlanta, where rides are matched through the Lyft app rather than sold as an AV-only service.
metrics: Driver-out commercial deployment reported in Peachtree Corners; Lyft partnership in Atlanta
signal: ECARX platform deal to scale fleet; in NVIDIA/Uber L4 ecosystem (May 2026)

sources.title: Lyft and May Mobility deploy their first autonomous vehicle fleet in Atlanta
